---
title: "Data: international relations and conflict"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("data/catalogue/helpers.R")
downloads <- utils::read.csv("data/catalogue/downloads.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ids <- c("gdelt", "polecat", "phoenix-cline", "ucdp", "atop", "africa-mfa-visits", "italy-diplomatic-visits", "russia-ukraine-mfa-visits", "us-leader-visits", "goldfish-datasets", "unhcr-refugees")
```

Events between states and political actors: machine-coded event data from news (GDELT, POLECAT, Phoenix), armed conflict dyads (UCDP), alliances (ATOP), diplomatic visits, fisheries treaties and refugee flows. Time is daily or yearly, actors are countries, and global covariates such as commodity prices or ENSO enter naturally through time-shifted sampling.

The [data catalogue](data-catalogue.html) lists every dataset with its licence. Figures
and numbers on this page are aggregates computed from the files as published;
each section links the source and the code that reads it.

```{r summary-table}
summary_table(ids)
```

```{r sections, results = "asis"}
render_group(ids)
```
